card.title: Parallel engines
card.subtitle: Claude Code (Claude subscription) and Codex (ChatGPT subscription) side by side: how Orkestr spreads agents over them.

form.codexRolesHint: These agent roles run on Codex, all others on Claude Code.
form.codexRolesSplitOnly: Used in the «Split by role» mode.
form.crossFallback: Switch to the other engine when a plan limit is reached
form.crossFallbackHint: The other subscription becomes the first fallback; previous fallbacks stay after it.

off.title: Off
off.description: Orkestr does not change routing: each agent uses its own model.

single.title: One engine
single.description: Everything runs on the main engine; the other one is the fallback.

split.title: Split by role
split.description: Chosen roles run on Codex, the rest on Claude Code.

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.description: Each new agent goes to the engine with fewer running agents and more limit left.

race.title: Race
race.description: Reviews are split between the engines: the Manager's engine reviews, the other engine double-checks it as the adversarial reviewer.

consensus.title: Consensus
consensus.description: Important decisions are agreed between both engines.

codexCard.title: Codex (ChatGPT subscription)
codexCard.subtitle: OpenAI's official Codex CLI with your ChatGPT plan: install, sign in and chat in the Codex panel.
codexCard.hint: Agents run on Codex once the parallel engines below say so. Orkestr never reads Codex's credential files.

hint.claudeCode: Runs on the Claude subscription (Claude Code)

reason.claudeNotInstalled: Claude Code is not installed (install the Claude Code extension or the CLI).
